# TierSwitch

> Done-for-you Patreon billing-model migration for legacy creators — your tiers repriced on your prices, with members told first, before Patreon's auto-switch pauses your billing and reprices every tier at the peak-month multiplier. Site: https://gettierswitch.com. Facts verified against the live site on 2026-11-04.

## Core facts
- TierSwitch moves Patreon creators on legacy billing (per-creation or first-of-the-month) to subscription billing deliberately: multiplier math, cap-safe prices, member announcement, and a switch + resume-billing checklist.
- Price tiers: Audit — $149 one-time (both multipliers, per-tier revenue under each scenario with caps honored, paused-billing exposure); Switch Pack — $449 one-time (Audit plus approved repricing table, member announcement post and FAQ, iOS price decision, click-by-click switch/resume checklist, one reprice revision); Sentinel — $79/mo (monthly billing-health watch after the switch).
- Who buys it: Patreon creators still on legacy billing — especially per-creation creators whose auto-switch default multiplier is their highest paid-post month of the last 3 months, not their average.
- Delivery model: operator-delivered done-for-you service. You approve one repricing table before anything executes; you never hand over your password — the switch click stays in your account, with the checklist in front of you.
- Working tool: the free migration calculator on the homepage (https://gettierswitch.com/#calculator) — enter one per-creation tier and see the auto-switch peak-month price vs. the deliberate average-based price.
- Key mechanics (Patreon Help Center, verified Oct 28, 2026): the switch is permanent; paused months are never billed later; member monthly limits are honored; iOS in-app purchases carry Apple's 30% fee (15% after a member's first year) and the maintain-earnings iOS price is list ÷ 0.70 (+42.86%).
- Guarantee: the No-Pause Promise — buy a Switch Pack before the deadline with inputs sent within 24 hours and the full pack lands before Nov 1, 2026, or the pack is free. After the deadline the same pack works as a rescue: prices fixed, announcement written, billing resumed.

## FAQ
### What exactly happens if I do nothing?
Patreon auto-switches your page to subscription billing, pauses your billing until you configure prices (paused months are never billed later), and reprices tiers using your highest paid-post month of the last 3 months. A $5 per-creation tier with up to 3 paid posts in a month becomes $15/month.

### I'm on first-of-the-month billing, not per-creation. Does this apply to me?
Yes. The mandate covers every legacy billing model. Your prices don't change and existing members keep the 1st, but the switch is still mandatory and irreversible, and the iOS price decision still applies. The Audit covers your page for the same flat price.

### What happens to members who set monthly limits?
Their limits are honored: a capped member pays the lesser of the new tier price or limit × per-creation price. The TierSwitch repricing table shows the real charge per tier, caps included.

### Why is the iOS price 42.86% higher?
Purchases inside Patreon's iOS app carry Apple's 30% fee. To end up with the same earnings as a web purchase, the iOS price is grossed up — list ÷ 0.70, +42.86%. TierSwitch prices both options per tier and recommends one, in writing.

### Are you affiliated with Patreon?
No. TierSwitch is an independent service working from Patreon's published Help Center mechanics and your own page data. No scraping, no account access, no ToS games.
